integrity: Finite integer proof via an executable acyclic discrete-Morse matching and exact signed chain verifiers. No external independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Single bidirected five-vertex wheel; no uniform formula for other sizes; rational, not integral, irreducible representation decomposition. Indexed-literature searches cannot exclude unindexed duplication.
title: A mixed sphere wedge and dihedral homology for the bidirected five-vertex wheel
